text:
Maria: FYI saw a canary failure on OpenLLaMA-30B (int4) during the nightly perf sweep. multiple OOMs on 80k token streams.
Samir: Ugh, logs?
Maria: paste of the main error:
```
2025-11-15T07:22:13Z ERROR inference::runtime: GPU OOM while allocating 2.3GiB for KV cache
stack: ..../runtime/src/kv_cache.rs:412
Context: serving request id=rc-9a2, seq=1023, max_new_tokens=1024, batch_size=6
```
Maria: This only shows up when batch_size >= 6 and when we keep max_new_tokens at the old default 1024.
Taylor: Sounds like KV cache growth + memory fragmentation. int4 helps reduce model weights but KV cache still scales with context. Did we enable kv_compaction in the backend for this model?
Maria: Not for this canary. Default config inherited from generic-30b profile.
Olivia: Two quick levers: (1) reduce default max_new_tokens for streaming endpoints to 256 for this model, (2) turn on periodic KV compaction/eviction for long seqs. That combo fixed a similar Falcon case.
Samir: Agree. Also bump prefetch window down so we don't pre-allocate huge KV slices per request. Example diff I'm proposing:
```
model_profiles/openllama-30b.yaml:
  max_new_tokens: 256
  default_batch_size: 4
  kv_compaction: true
  kv_compaction_threshold: 0.7
  prefetch_kv_tokens: 512
```
Taylor: kv_compaction_threshold 0.7 means we compact when fragmented memory >70%? good heuristic.
Maria: Can we try a canary with that config? Also would like to run a quick perf/eval: compare generation latency and p50/p95 token cost before/after.
infra-bot: Deploy request queued: canary/openllama-30b/compaction-sweep by Samir. ID: deploy-50021
Samir: I'll kick the canary with 10% traffic and synthetic long-seq load (seq_len 64k, new_tokens 512) and watch mem graphs.
Olivia: Also add an eval run for our regression harness: prompt-set/long-context-cover.json to detect quality regressions after quant change.
Maria: Noted. Heads-up: if compaction changes scheduling we might see slightly higher p99 spikes; watch for throughput regressions.
Taylor: If we still see OOMs, next step is per-request KV cap: enforce max_kv_size = 48MB per request and small eviction policy.
Samir: Ok will report back in ~20m with canary logs. If green, roll defaults for profile.
Maria: Thanks team :thumbsup:
Samir: canary logs: first run looks good, memory stabilized, no OOMs in 30m. p95 token latency +3% but cost down ~9% from int4 gains.
Maria: Awesome. Filing follow-up PR to update model profile and add eval evidence.
Olivia: PR should include before/after eval artifacts + plots.
Maria: Assigned to Samir for PR and Taylor for monitoring alerts.
Samir: on it.
infra-bot: Canary deploy deploy-50021 finished: success -> promoted to staging (10%)."
